budgets.project_summary: Mobile banking app with instant transfers and card management

components.name: Authentication backend
components.description: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect login with refresh tokens, device binding and biometric re-authentication for retail banking customers.

components.name: Instant transfers
components.description: Real-time SEPA instant transfers with idempotency keys, limits per customer and fraud scoring hooks.

components.name: Card management
components.description: Freeze, unfreeze and replace cards, view PIN securely and configure spending limits.

components.name: Mobile client
components.description: Flutter client for iOS and Android with accessibility support and offline-friendly account overview.

budgets.project_summary: Patient scheduling and teleconsultation platform for private clinics

components.name: Appointment scheduling
components.description: Calendar with doctor availability, automatic reminders by SMS and email, and rescheduling rules.

components.name: Teleconsultation
components.description: Browser video calls between doctor and patient with waiting room and session recording consent.

components.name: Medical records
components.description: Structured patient records with role-based access, audit trail and export to PDF.

components.name: Billing
components.description: Invoicing per consultation with tax receipts and payment links.

budgets.project_summary: E-commerce storefront with loyalty program and inventory sync

components.name: Product catalog
components.description: Searchable catalog with faceted filters, variants and image optimisation.

components.name: Checkout
components.description: Cart, address book, multiple payment methods and order confirmation emails.

components.name: Loyalty program
components.description: Points accrual and redemption, tiers, and campaign rules configurable by marketing.

components.name: Inventory sync
components.description: Nightly and event-driven stock synchronisation with the warehouse ERP.

budgets.project_summary: Fleet tracking and delivery route optimisation dashboard

components.name: Live vehicle tracking
components.description: Ingestion of GPS telemetry from trucks with live map and geofence alerts.

components.name: Route optimisation
components.description: Daily route planning with time windows and capacity constraints using a vehicle routing solver.

components.name: Operations reports
components.description: Weekly delivery performance reports with on-time rate and cost per kilometre.

components.name: Authentication backend
components.description: JWT-based authorization service with roles for dispatchers, drivers and administrators.

budgets.project_summary: Online learning platform with courses, quizzes and certificates

components.name: Course authoring
components.description: Editor to create lessons with video, rich text and downloadable resources.

components.name: Quizzes and grading
components.description: Question banks, timed quizzes with automatic grading and attempt analytics.

components.name: Certificates
components.description: Automatic PDF certificates with verification codes after course completion.

components.name: Single sign-on
components.description: SAML single sign-on for university customers.

budgets.project_summary: Claims intake portal with document upload and automated triage

components.name: Claim intake form
components.description: Multi-step claim submission with validation, draft saving and photo upload from mobile.

components.name: Document extraction
components.description: OCR and field extraction from invoices and police reports with confidence scores.

components.name: Automated triage
components.description: Rules and a classification model to route claims to adjusters by severity and fraud risk.

components.name: Customer notifications
components.description: Status updates by email and WhatsApp throughout the claim lifecycle.
